offline.question: Does it work offline?
offline.answer: Yes. Recording and transcription run on-device, so you can capture ideas even with no connection.

privacy.question: Where is my data stored?
privacy.answer: By default your voice notes and transcripts stay on your device. You control if and when AI cloud features are used.

privateMode.question: Is Private mode always on?
privateMode.answer: No. Private mode is optional in Settings. It is available on supported devices after downloading a local model.

languages.question: Which languages are supported?
languages.answer: Voice Inbox AI supports multi-language speech recognition and keeps improving model quality over time.

pricing.question: Do I need a subscription to start?
pricing.answer: No. You can install and start using core voice capture immediately, then upgrade only if advanced AI workflows are needed.

backupViewer.question: Can I open my backup on a computer?
backupViewer.answer: Yes. Export a ZIP from Settings → Import / Export in the app, then open it in our <link>browser backup viewer</link>. Nothing is uploaded to our servers.

supportPage.heading: Support
supportPage.body: Use this page to ask questions about Voice Inbox AI, subscriptions, privacy, or technical issues. The fastest way to reach us is by email. You can also send a message from the app (Settings → About → Contact support), which attaches helpful diagnostics.
supportPage.emailMissing: Support email is not configured on this deployment. Use the in-app support form in Voice Inbox AI (Settings).
supportPage.bulletApp: For billing or subscription questions, check your receipt in the App Store or Google Play, or write to us with your purchase details.
supportPage.bulletPrivacy: For data and privacy questions, read our Privacy Policy (linked below) or email us with specifics.

viewerPage.heading: Backup viewer
viewerPage.introShort: Open a backup ZIP from the Voice Inbox AI app — everything stays in your browser.
viewerPage.introDetail: Export a backup from the app (Settings → Import / Export), then choose or drop the ZIP here. Your notes are never uploaded to our servers.
viewerPage.howToExportTitle: How to export a backup from the app
viewerPage.howToExportStep1: Open Voice Inbox AI → Settings → Import / Export.
viewerPage.howToExportStep2: Tap Export backup and save the ZIP file (optionally set a password).
viewerPage.howToExportStep3: Return here and choose or drop that ZIP to browse your notes in the browser.
viewerPage.dragZipHint: Or drag and drop a file (max about {maxMb} MB).
viewerPage.privacyInline: Nothing is uploaded to our servers — processing stays in this tab.
viewerPage.searchPlaceholder: Search title, tags, transcript, speaker turns, marks…
viewerPage.keyboardHint: Tip: ↑ ↓ or J / K in the list when search is not focused.
viewerPage.dropHint: Or tap to choose a file. Maximum size about {maxMb} MB.
viewerPage.replaceBackupAria: Choose a different backup ZIP file
viewerPage.dropReplaceHint: Drop another ZIP here to replace this backup.
viewerPage.privacyNoteCompact: Still only in your browser — close the tab to clear from memory.
viewerPage.privacyNote: All unpacking and reading happens locally in your browser. Close the tab or reload to clear the data from memory.
viewerPage.skippedInvalidNotes: {count, plural, one {# note had errors and was skipped.} other {# notes had errors and were skipped.}}
viewerPage.skippedInvalidFolders: {count, plural, one {# folder had errors and was skipped.} other {# folders had errors and were skipped.}}
viewerPage.speakerTurnsIntro: Estimated speaker lines from the meeting-style pass (same as in the app).
viewerPage.recordingMarksIntro: Bookmarks you added while recording; times are offsets in the final audio.
viewerPage.emptySpeakerTurns: No speaker breakdown in this backup.
viewerPage.emptyRecordingMarks: No recording marks in this backup.
viewerPage.audioMissing: Audio file was not found inside this archive.
viewerPage.selectPrompt: Select a note from the list.
